pages.heading:
BELLWEATHER POLICE DEPARTMENT
INCIDENT REPORT — No. 36-114
pages.text:
Date: Tuesday, November 17, 1936
Location: Vale residence, Meridian Road
Reporting officer: Sgt. H. Dunmore

Called 6:40 a.m. by the dairy driver, who found the kitchen door open and no answer from Mrs. A. Pell, housekeeper.

On arrival: dinner for eleven laid and served in the dining hall, plates half finished. Fires lit in four rooms, burned low. Coats and hats on the hall rack. Papers on the dining table (collected, see attached). No sign of forced entry. No persons on the premises.

The tall clock in the west library found stopped at 2:17.

Door between the main hall and the west wing locked and bolted FROM THE INSIDE. Entered by drawing the hinge pins. West wing rooms empty.

Eleven persons unaccounted for. List attached.
